source.title: Call for Applicants - WEC Members (September 2021)
source.content:
The WCA Ethics Committee (WEC) is seeking new members to help them with their mission! The applications are open to everyone; it’s not a requirement to hold a current position in the WCA to be considered.

**What does the WEC do?**

* Maintaining and updating the Code of Ethics.
* Ensures that all procedures followed by WCA Staff abide by the Code of Ethics.
* Performs independent investigations if any WCA Staff member is not compliant with said Code of Ethics.
* Confidant for Registered Speedcubers that request investigations.
* Functions as the board of appeal if any involved party disagrees with a decision made by the WCA Disciplinary Committee.

The official rights and duties of the WEC are documented in [WCA Motion 10.2021.4](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2021.4%20-%20Ethics%20Committee.pdf).

**The qualities and requirements expected of candidates are:**

* Clear background
* Personal time management skills
* Ability to discuss reasoning and ideas
* Familiarity with WCA activities

The application period is open for applicants to submit their application documents from now until **October 3rd, 2021, 23:59 UTC** to Blake Thompson ([bthompson@worldcubeassociation.org](mailto:bthompson@worldcubeassociation.org)).

**Candidacy documents must be in PDF format, and must include:**

* A brief personal introduction
* Summary of activities done within the cubing community
* Motivation for applying to join the WEC

Applicants can expect an immediate reply to confirm the receipt of the application, and may later receive a request to be interviewed. Anyone with questions about applying can contact Blake Thompson ([bthompson@worldcubeassociation.org](mailto:bthompson@worldcubeassociation.org)).

After the application period, the WEC Leader will make a selection and the new members will be announced once applicants have accepted the positions.

Thank you for your candidacies and support!

translation.title: 招募 WCA 道德委员会成员（2021 年 9 月）
translation.content:
WCA 道德委员会（WEC）正在招募新成员，一起完成委员会的工作！所有人都可以申请，不要求申请者目前已在 WCA 任职。

**WEC 负责什么？**

* 维护和更新《道德准则》。
* 确保 WCA 工作人员遵循的各项程序符合《道德准则》。
* 对 WCA 工作人员不遵守《道德准则》的情况开展独立调查。
* 作为提出调查请求的注册速拧选手的可信赖联系人。
* 若相关方不接受 WCA 纪律委员会的决定，担任申诉机构。

WEC 的正式权利与职责载于 [WCA 议案 10.2021.4](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2021.4%20-%20Ethics%20Committee.pdf)。

**我们希望候选人具备以下条件：**

* 无不良记录。
* 能合理安排自己的时间。
* 能够讨论观点并说明理由。
* 熟悉 WCA 的工作与活动。

申请期从即日起至 **2021 年 10 月 3 日 23:59 UTC**，请将材料发送给 Blake Thompson（[bthompson@worldcubeassociation.org](mailto:bthompson@worldcubeassociation.org)）。

**申请材料须为 PDF 格式，并包含：**

* 简短的个人介绍。
* 曾在魔方社区开展的工作概述。
* 申请加入 WEC 的原因。

申请者会及时收到确认收件的回复，之后可能获邀参加面试。如对申请有疑问，可联系 Blake Thompson（[bthompson@worldcubeassociation.org](mailto:bthompson@worldcubeassociation.org)）。

申请期结束后，WEC 负责人将选出人选，在申请者接受职位后公布新成员名单。

感谢大家的申请与支持！
